captions.gbp:
Have an ultrasound coming up? How you prepare depends on the type. For an abdominal ultrasound, don't eat for 8 to 12 hours before (water is OK). For a pelvic ultrasound, drink 32 oz of water 1 hour before and don't empty your bladder, because a full bladder gives clearer pictures. Thyroid, breast and vascular ultrasounds need no special prep. Wear loose, comfortable clothes and leave jewelry at home. If you're using insurance, bring your card and your doctor's order, and plan to arrive 15 minutes early. Ultrasound is painless and uses no radiation: warm gel and a smooth probe glide over your skin, and most exams take 20 to 45 minutes. Afterward you can get right back to your day, and results go to your doctor in 48 to 72 hours. Self-pay ultrasound at our Seminole office is $195, with no referral needed and same-day appointments often available. Always follow the instructions from your doctor or our team.

Book online at advancedimg.com. General information, not medical advice.

facts_checked: Checked 2026-10-17. RadiologyInfo.org (ACR/RSNA) Abdominal Ultrasound: little to no prep, doctor says whether to stop eating or drinking, loose clothing, leave jewelry at home, may wear a gown, no radiation, painless. RadiologyInfo.org Pelvic Ultrasound: may be asked to drink water to fill the bladder (transabdominal), usually done within 30 minutes, no radiation. NIH MedlinePlus Abdominal ultrasound: likely asked not to eat or drink for several hours; little discomfort, gel may feel cold, probe pressed against abdomen. Practice facts from amiweb 712b9df: services-data.ts ultrasound prepItems (abdominal fast 8 to 12 hours, water OK; pelvic 32 oz water 1 hour before, don't empty bladder; thyroid/breast/MSK/vascular no prep; loose clothing; arrive 15 min early with card and order), duration 20 to 45 min, results 48 to 72 hours, self-pay no referral, same-day often; pricing/page.tsx Routine Ultrasound $195; constants.ts phone and hours.
flag: Hook photo service-ultrasound.jpg is website stock (a prenatal scan; not called our team or patient). Ultrasound room photo is the real Seminole office. Website pelvic prep (full bladder) only covers the through-the-belly exam; a transvaginal pelvic ultrasound is usually done with an empty bladder (RadiologyInfo), which the website doesn't mention.
